# CapitalKnob

> CapitalKnob helps businesses and individuals unlock their capital potential with smart financial solutions, funding support, and strategic capital guidance.

## Overview
CapitalKnob is an Indian financial advisory firm providing tailored capital solutions across Business Finance, Home Loans, Real Estate Finance, and Private Credit.

- Website: https://www.capitalknob.com/
- Office: No. 8, 1st Floor, 24th Main, 5th Phase, JP Nagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560078
- Phone: +91 99869 00144
- Email: advisory@capitalknob.com

## Financial Services
- [Home Finance](https://www.capitalknob.com/home-finance): Home loans, balance transfer, renovation loans, loan against property, top-up loans.
- [Business Finance](https://www.capitalknob.com/business-finance): Secured business loans, working capital finance, machinery funding, business expansion capital.
- [Real Estate Finance](https://www.capitalknob.com/real-estate-finance): Construction finance, property acquisition, land development capital.
- [Private Credit](https://www.capitalknob.com/private-credit): Bespoke institutional credit, mezzanine finance, flexible debt solutions.
- [About Us](https://www.capitalknob.com/about-us): Company leadership, vision, and operational values.
- [Contact](https://www.capitalknob.com/contact): Advisory booking, direct inquiry form, and office location.
